picks.name: Occidental Petroleum Corporation
picks.thesis: This is a war-premium trade, and it should be labelled as one. OXY is 15% below its 52-week high with three-month momentum at -7.4% and the RS line 27% off its high — the score comes from a 4-contraction VCP, EPS +315.6% and a bounce off the 54.82 50-DMA, not from leadership. TradingView says BUY (15/1). The upside is real if Hormuz disruption persists; a de-escalation headline takes it straight back to the lows.
strengths: EPS +315.6% off a depressed base at 14.3x forward
Reclaimed the 50-DMA (54.82) and holds well above the 200-DMA (49.75)
0% short float — no crowded bear position
Direct leverage to any further Middle East supply disruption
risks: Revenue -8.3% and 3-month momentum -7.4% — this is not a growth story
RS line 27% off its high: the weakest relative strength in this list
Entirely dependent on the geopolitical premium holding
Earnings 6 Aug
